passages.text:
COVID response priorities involving the private sector
[contact omitted] Adam Tomasek
atb.com
Wednesday, October 6, 2021 at 12:11:52 PM Eastern Daylight Time
Hi Payton. It has been some time since we last spoke, but I expect you may have had more recent engagements with
USAID colleagues Sabeen Dhanani and Amy Lin.
I am wondering if you are still the point of contact for COVID response issues? If not, could you kindly connect me to the
right person? I would like to schedule some time for a short call to discuss recent updates on the USG response priorities.
You likely saw info about President Biden's hosting of the Global COVID Summit last week, but if not here is a White
House fact sheet as well as the Summit summary An area of emphasis for our efforts is focused on engaging the private
sector, and I would like to discuss some ideas which may be of interest to Facebook. I look forward to finding a time to
speak with you.
Best, Adam
Adam J. Tomasek
Global Lead, Private Sector Engagement
USAID COVID-19 TASK FORCE
Office of the Administrator
